verdicts.why: 'a' => 'to' glosses the particle in 'riesco a ricordare', and the seed target 'I can remember' renders no 'to'.
'tutto' => 'everything' glosses a word of the seed and its LEGO 'tutto il giorno', but the seed renders it as 'all'; the policy for this is Tom's call.
'not' is the literal gloss of 'non', but the seed target has the contraction "wouldn't", so 'not' is not a contiguous substring.
'not' glosses 'non', but the seed target has the contraction "won't".
'ho' => 'I have' is the literal gloss of the auxiliary, but the seed target renders 'ho detto' as 'I said'.
'to put yourself' glosses 'mettersi' literally, but the seed and its LEGO render 'mettersi alla prova' as 'test yourself'.
'(progressive: are ~ing)' is a grammatical annotation of 'います' that the seed 'what are you looking for?' does not render as a separate substring.
'いい' => 'good/better' is a part of the LEGO '方がいい' => 'should', and the seed target says 'should consider'.
'を' => '(object marker)' is a particle with no English counterpart in 'what are you looking for?'.
'方' => 'way/option' is a part of the LEGO '方がいい' => 'should', and the seed target renders it as 'should'.
'not possible' is a gloss of 'できません', while the seed target says "wasn't possible".
'います' => 'am' glosses the auxiliary of '楽しんでいます', which the seed renders as 'I enjoy'.
'ください' => 'please' belongs to its own LEGO '手伝ってください', but the seed known text is '手伝ってくれますか' and the target has no 'please'.
'ない' => "can't / not" glosses the negation in '見えない', and the seed has "can't see" with the verb interposed.
'大' => 'big' is a kanji split of '大丈夫' => 'okay', and the seed target has no 'big'.
'いた' => 'was' is an auxiliary gloss, and the seed target says 'we were talking'.
'ぐるぐる' => 'around and around' glosses an adverb, and the seed target says 'going around' with no repeat.
'も' => 'even if / for' glosses a particle in '待っても', and the seed target has 'waiting for'.
'か' => '(question marker)' is a particle with no English counterpart in the seed.
'こと' => '-ing' is the nominaliser inside '間違えること' => 'making mistakes', and '-ing' is not a contiguous substring.
